[SWS_SM_00666] Nested recovery
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00601
⌈
In case that a new issue is reported and the issue has to be handled by a
StateMa-
chine
where internal flag ErrorRecoveryOngoing is set (see [SWS_SM_00601]), this
shall be considered as "nested recovery" (see [SWS_SM_00031]).
⌋
